what: WORKED COMPUTATION (independent run 1 of 2): Block 12's exact noise map, for four predecessors. The six-axis record at a site with four recorded predecessors takes axis a with probability proportional to prod_j W(a, s_j) (W = p same axis, q opposite, r orthogonal). (1) Enumerate the predecessor patterns up to the cube group (unanimous; 3-1 with the odd one opposite or orthogonal; 2-2 in its variants; 2-1-1; 1-1-1-1) and give for each the exact law of the record as rational functions of (p,q,r). (2) Give the two domination parameters of block 30 in this setting: the probability of leaving a unanimous neighbourhood, and of following the minority in a 3-1 neighbourhood; evaluate on (p,1,2) and on (e^b, e^-b, 1). (3) Tie cases (2-2): state the law exactly; this is where four predecessors differ from three. Expectation: the probability of leaving a unanimous neighbourhood is (q^4 + 4 r^4)/(p^4 + q^4 + 4 r^4); check every formula against brute-force enumeration at three random rational weights. DELIVERABLE in your unit worktree: probes/work/compute/six-axis-noise-map-3plus1/<your worker name>/run.py (self-contained; exact arithmetic wherever the statement is exact; numpy only for the numerical cross-checks named) and RESULT.md (the table or formulas, in plain text). run.py prints one line per result, a final `SUMMARY: <the main result in one line>`, and `HIT: <what>` ONLY if a result contradicts the expectation stated in the task (that is the interesting case: report it precisely). Two workers do each computation independently; the supervisor compares them. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/compute/six-axis-noise-map-3plus1/<name>/run.py"
